title: HR & Policies
problem: Staff ask HR the same policy questions every day, and the answers are buried in long handbooks.
value: Self-service answers around the clock, each with a citation to the exact policy, so HR spends less time on repeat questions.
questions: How many days of annual leave do I get, and can I carry any over?
What is the maximum hotel rate in London?
Can I fly business class to New York?
What happens if I submit an expense claim after 60 days?

title: Contracts & Legal
problem: Contracts are long and dense, and people sign them without knowing their obligations.
value: Plain-language answers to contract questions, each pointing to the exact clause and page, so reviews take minutes instead of hours.
questions: How much notice do I need to give to leave early?
Can I keep a dog in the flat?
How fast must the landlord fix a broken heater?
By how much can the rent go up each year?

title: Customer Support
problem: Support teams answer the same how-to and warranty questions that the manual already covers.
value: Questions get answered straight from the manual and warranty, which reduces support tickets and keeps answers consistent.
questions: My router light is solid amber. What should I do?
How do I factory reset the router?
How can I extend my warranty to 3 years?
Can I return an opened router for a refund?
